summary: EOrientation is a web page for managing access to a Moodle site for course orientation, specifically designed for staff with roles such as instructors and administrators. It also manages course retakes and provides certificate printing for course completion.
purpose: The EOrientation page facilitates course orientation management, including user authentication and interfacing with an external Moodle site. Staff can retake completed courses and print completion certificates.

workflows.name: Course Retake Workflow
steps: Check staff permission to retake course.
Trigger retake command for selected course.

validations: Ensure UserSession is active before allowing operations.
Confirm course completion before allowing retake.
system_behavior: Automatically submit form if user has CMOrientation permissions.
exceptions: Cancel operations if UserSession is null.
